protocol.translation_mode: auto, original question only; no evidence or reference answer sent
protocol.scope: all five target-language documents, admin role, verified frozen document-language map
protocol.qrels: any mapped non-whitespace overlap with a required evidence span; OR alternatives and partial spans included; unjudged counted nonrelevant but not exhaustive
protocol.latency: Warm stages; query encoding timed once per unique question and shared across its two target-language cases; default production SQL over temporary frozen corpus, optional offline adapter reported separately. Cached translation excludes API latency; excludes generation and model startup.
protocol.generation_metrics: Not measured here; An owns answer/citation/faithfulness evaluation.
protocol.human_review: User approved requested H10/H13/H19 changes; assistant verified source mapping. Not independently certified human annotation.
protocol.limitation: New questions on previously seen simulated corpus; assistant authored with development context. Related topics and shared tables remain; not independent-domain/generalization proof.

timing: warm stages; shared fresh query encoding per case; cached translator; excludes API translation/generation/model startup; raw translated-hybrid timing is its pre-rerank stage
